# A book kept in CAD whose `company` block writes dates as `%d %B %Y`, which
# GnuCash has no date style for.
#
# What this fixture produces: Assets:Bank 500.00 CAD opened against
# Equity:Opening Balances on 2026-01-02, and the book option Fancy Date Format
# set to `%d %B %Y`. Imported with --include-business-objects, which is what
# imports a `company` block. A report drawn for it warns that GnuCash has no
# date style for that format.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_the_statements_are_printed_by_customized_gnucash_reports.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity:Opening Balances
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

company
	name: "A Company Writing Its Own Dates"
	date_format: "%d %B %Y"

2026-01-02 * "Opening balance"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 500.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening Balances -500.00 CAD
